-- Rab Bothy Activation (2025) - Outdoor brand activation for Rab outdoor gear
UPDATE projects 
SET seoKeywords = 'outdoor brand activation, Rab gear, experiential marketing, Lumenati, immersive installation'
WHERE title = 'Rab Bothy Activation';

-- Add display tags (using INSERT IGNORE for MySQL compatibility)
INSERT IGNORE INTO tags (name, slug) VALUES 
  ('Outdoor Activation', 'outdoor-activation'),
  ('Brand Experience', 'brand-experience'),
  ('Lumenati', 'lumenati');

INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id
FROM projects p, tags t
WHERE p.title = 'Rab Bothy Activation'
  AND t.slug IN ('outdoor-activation', 'brand-experience', 'lumenati', '2025')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM projectTags pt 
    WHERE pt.projectId = p.id AND pt.tagId = t.id
  );
